integrity: Proof is reproduced by self-contained Python standard-library construction, complete Hasse acyclicity, exact signed two-to-three Morse elimination with an independent direct unit-pivot cross-check, and modular simplicial homology comparisons. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the fully bidirected K_{2,4} and K_{2,5} only. No family-wide generalization or equivariant homotopy statement. Equivalent unindexed results are a residual originality risk.
title: Two-torsion Moore summands in multipath complexes of bidirected complete bipartite graphs
